title: Export my data
description: Download a copy of your personal data (GDPR portability).

JSON.label: JSON
JSON.hint: Structured file, ideal for re-importing your data or technical use. Instant download.

MARKDOWN.label: Markdown
MARKDOWN.hint: Readable text document, formatted for reading. Instant download.

ZIP.label: ZIP (full archive)
ZIP.hint: Archive bundling all your data and files. Prepared in the background.

CSV.label: CSV (spreadsheet)
CSV.hint: Tables compatible with Excel or Google Sheets. Prepared in the background.

preparing.status: Preparing your export: {status}. This may take a moment.

ready.expired: This download link has expired. Request again to generate a new export.

errors.network: A network error occurred. Please try again.
errors.jobFailed: Export preparation failed. Please try again.
